question: Can prepared signals produce local arithmetic click records and common-cause correlations under unchanged Rule3, and do the full-trial correlations violate CHSH?
status: Frozen before new trajectories; no adaptive parameter search

apparatus.setting_support: Only initial receiver channels 0 and 14; all other initial state components fixed for a given source phase pair
apparatus.meaning: Local preparation settings and designed common-cause phases; not physical polarization settings or demonstrated physical light

ensembles.shared_phase: All four uniform shared phases crossed with all four local setting pairs: 16 runs
ensembles.independent_phases: All sixteen uniform ordered phase pairs crossed with all four local setting pairs: 64 runs
ensembles.null: Both sources absent crossed with all four local setting pairs: 4 runs
ensembles.sampling: Exact finite enumeration; phase weights independent of settings; no trials discarded

readout.primary_address: Channel 0 at each receiver; the complete 48-channel receiver is also retained
readout.arithmetic_click: ell = next.b + previous.a; guarded C iff ell != 0 and complete local triple changes
readout.outcome: Sign of ell for the first guarded C in steps 1..16; 0 if none
readout.signed_record_scope: The first-click sign is an external read-only trajectory statistic, not an established persistent internal signed memory
readout.local_memory: I=a^2+b^2 at receiver channel0; report constancy after first C through step16, remainder-pair constancy and all later C events separately
readout.primary_correlation: E_xy = mean(A*B) over every run of each declared ensemble and setting pair, retaining all zero outcomes
readout.secondary: Compute paired-click-conditioned E and CHSH only as selection diagnostics; report all local and joint detection rates and outcome marginals
readout.no_signalling_audit: Compare complete local detector trajectories across the remote setting for each fixed phase pair and local setting; equality follows from the bounded causal geometry, not proof of quantum no-signalling

causal_domain.no_boundary_wrap: Every initial nonbackground address and its radius16 support remain inside coordinates0..96

acceptance.computational_validity: 84 completed full recordings, exact rewind on every transition and entire run, unchanged sources/tensor, declared phase weights and settings preserved
acceptance.source_dependence: Null controls have no receiver C; at least one source-on case has receiver C no earlier than source distance8
acceptance.finite_memory: Report number of receiver records whose I and remainder pair remain constant from first C through16; do not silently require sign retention or indefinite persistence
acceptance.classical_correlation: Compare shared-phase and independent-phase E matrices without changing the observer
acceptance.Bell_nonlocality: A full-trial S>2 would trigger implementation/assumption audit; S<=2 is a bounded result consistent with local factorization, not a proof that no quantum state is entangled
acceptance.strict_waiting: Report whether any later receiver C follows the first; first-click-only observation does not mean an internal latch suppressed later clicks
acceptance.failure: Record rejected preparations, runtime-budget failures, missing clicks and nonpersistent memories as results; do not retune after data
acceptance.continuation: Develop a separately registered internal herald/sign-memory preparation only if the present audit establishes a reliable signal-triggered record; quantum claims require operational setting/calibration derivation and loophole-controlled comparisons

model_contract: Initial preparation only; fixed +++ tensor; Rule3 only; no runtime source, gate, veto, erasure, history selector or external approval; Presenter and observers are read-only
